title: Sailor Moon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Middle schooler Usagi Tsukino learns from a talking cat, Luna, that she is the reincarnated princess of the ancient Moon Kingdom and can transform into Sailor Moon. With fellow Sailor Guardians Ami, Rei, Makoto and Minako, and later allies including Tuxedo Mask, Chibiusa and the outer Guardians, she fights cosmic villains for the Silver Crystal. Friendship, destined love and repeated deaths and rebirths run through the five arcs.
life_message: It holds up love, loyalty among friends and the courage of an ordinary girl as the power that saves the world.
